original_snippet: scripts/run.sh -> scripts/run.sh; scripts/stop.sh -> scripts/stop.sh; scripts/run-last-healthy-config.sh -> scripts/run-last-healthy-config.sh fixed argv wrappers
rust_snippet: const RUN_SCRIPT: &[&str] = &["scripts/run.sh"]; const STOP_SCRIPT: &[&str] = &["scripts/stop.sh"]; const RUN_LAST_HEALTHY_SCRIPT: &[&str] = &["scripts/run-last-healthy-config.sh"]; run_fixed_argv(argv, repo_root, DEFAULT_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT)
description: Maps IGY6 operational CLI commands to existing Bash scripts through fixed argv arrays.
how_it_works: The CLI dispatcher selects a compile-time argv slice for run, stop, or run-last-healthy, then spawns the first argv item with the remaining items as arguments from the repository root.
why_useful: Preserves existing operator scripts while preventing arbitrary shell command execution during the Rust CLI migration.
behavior_preserved: The active Bash scripts remain responsible for Docker Compose startup, shutdown, and last-healthy startup behavior.
inputs: CLI command: run, stop, or run-last-healthy
outputs: Subprocess stdout, stderr, and exit code with sensitive-looking lines redacted
side_effects: Same side effects as the existing selected Bash script; the Rust wrapper itself does not delete files or modify command arguments
safety_notes: Does not use shell string execution.
Does not store secrets or .env contents.
equivalence_limits: Rust wrapper does not replace the Bash script internals.
Timeout kills only the wrapper child process if exceeded.

description: Provides a safe Rust CLI config structure check without reading or printing local .env secrets.
how_it_works: The CLI reads repo-visible .env.example, parses non-comment key=value lines with a local repo-visible parser, verifies required keys, validates the manifest and Compose file existence, and reports counts instead of values.
why_useful: Gives the required igy6 config check command a deterministic local safety boundary while preserving the Bash scripts for runtime operations.
behavior_preserved: Keeps config validation focused on known repo-visible configuration structure and avoids exposing secret values.
outputs: Readable config check status with values redacted
safety_notes: Does not read IGY6_DATA_ROOT runtime/private data.
equivalence_limits: Does not validate live environment secrets or runtime service connectivity.
Full Rust config parity remains for a later config phase.
tests: cargo run -p igy6-cli --bin igy6 -- config check

description: Connects the Rust CLI config check to the dedicated Rust config validator while preserving non-printing behavior for config values.
how_it_works: The CLI invokes igy6-config for .env.example and .env structure validation, then reports redacted status plus manifest and Compose file presence.
why_useful: Moves config validation out of ad hoc CLI parsing into a reusable Rust crate without replacing active Bash operator scripts.
behavior_preserved: Keeps operator scripts active and avoids exposing secrets in CLI output.
equivalence_limits: Does not replace Bash runtime script behavior.
